name: Santa Monica Place
summary: Santa Monica Place is a contemporary open-air lifestyle center featuring luxury-brand shops, diverse dining options, and entertainment venues including a movie theater. Located in the heart of Santa Monica since 1980, this upscale three-level destination offers a sophisticated shopping experience just blocks from the Pacific Ocean.
demographics: Santa Monica Place attracts an affluent, educated demographic with household incomes significantly above the national average, drawing from the wealthy Westside Los Angeles communities including Santa Monica, Brentwood, and Pacific Palisades. The visitor base skews toward professionals aged 25-54, young families, and tourists seeking upscale shopping and dining experiences near the beach. The trade area benefits from high disposable income levels and a preference for premium brands, experiential retail, and coastal lifestyle amenities, with shoppers typically valuing quality over value pricing.
description: Santa Monica Place stands as a premier open-air shopping destination in the heart of Santa Monica, California, having served the community since 1980. This contemporary lifestyle center underwent a major transformation to become a sophisticated three-level shopping experience that seamlessly blends luxury retail, upscale dining, and entertainment just blocks from the Pacific Ocean. The center features an impressive collection of high-end retailers and designer boutiques, complemented by a diverse food court and modern movie theater that cater to both locals and the millions of tourists who visit Santa Monica annually. With its open-air design, the mall capitalizes on Southern California's ideal climate while offering stunning views and a relaxed, coastal atmosphere that distinguishes it from traditional enclosed shopping centers. The property's prime location at 395 Santa Monica Place, combined with its curated tenant mix and contemporary amenities, has established it as a cornerstone of the Westside Los Angeles retail landscape and a must-visit destination for discerning shoppers seeking both luxury brands and unique dining experiences.
